name: Large Warrior
displayDescription: Allows you to size up your warrior to an even larger size.

name: Autumn Fur Bundle 2024
displayDescription: Includes a variety of fur styles and manes to give your character that wild and untamed fall look: Curled Ear Tufts, Pointy Ear Tufts, a majestic Feathery Mane and Large Mane, rugged Scruffy Mane and Cheek Fur, and the bold Spiky Upwards Mane.  Additional fur details include the Chin Tuft and Under Ear Fur, Thin Downwards Mane, Flowy Furs, Fluffy Head Tuft, Silky Head Tuft and Back Fur, Swept Head Tufts, Inner Ear Fur, Long Inner Ear Fur, Long Downwards Cheek Fur, Round Cheek Fur, and Short Pointy Cheek Fur.

name: Winter Fur Bundle 2024
displayDescription: Transform your character with a massive selection of over 50 winter-themed fur details! Highlights include the cozy Frozen Leg Fluff, sleek Leafy Mane, elegant Longhair Tail Fur, and intricate Fur Cuffs. This bundle offers endless options for crafting the ultimate winter look—there's so much to explore!

name: Variety of Tail Furs
displayDescription: Fluff up your tail with this 8 pack of tail furs! This pack includes two tail tip furs and 6 full tail furs, including the Messy Tail Fur and Flow Tail Fur.

name: Eye Shines
displayDescription: A small bundle which includes Seven unique shines to decorate your eyes with.

name: Winter Markings Pack 2024
displayDescription: Enhance your character with a variety of intricate and bold markings! This pack features striking Skeletal Markings, classic Tabby Stripes, and unique Woodgrain Patterns. Explore even more designs to craft a look that's truly your own!

name: Greenleaf Pack 2025
displayDescription: Embrace the warmth of summer with this natural pack of 24 items full of flowers and fur! This pack features a blooming bright Flowering Eyepatch, floral decorations for the body, and two new furs. Sunbathe and relax with the fluffy Loose Mane and Loose Face Fur.

name: Eastern Dragon Bundle
displayDescription: Celebrate the conclusion of the Year of the Dragon with a powerful new set! This bundle includes Dragon Head Spikes, Fiery Tendrils, an Ethereal Mane, Dragon Talon Pads, and more! This set will let you embody the spirit of a legendary beast.

name: Blooming Spring Bundle 2026
displayDescription: Blooming flowers stretch out their leaves and give your cat a fashionable hug in this new natural accessory pack. Take the first signs of spring on tour with the Spring Bloom set or decorate your cat with fresh picked flowers using the Meadow Forager's set. For something more ethereal, walk on flowers with Flowering Paws or hold your head high with Flower Adorned Horns.

name: Starry Dreamer
displayDescription: Let the moon and stars guide you with this mystical 9 piece costume! Use the Dreamer's Carrier to deliver potions or enshroud yourself with the Patterned Shawl.

name: Face Details
displayDescription: Includes a variety of detailed features to personalize your character’s face: We have lashes like the Fluffy Lashes, Baggy Lashes, Spiky Lashes, Open Lashes, and Rounded Lashes. We also have Blaze options which include Thin Blaze, Triangular Blaze, Snip Blaze, Half Blaze, and Bridge Nose Blaze. Additional details include Lower Cheeks, Ear Brims, Small Freckles, Long Section Tears, and cute Heart Cheek Stamps.

name: Overgrown 2025
displayDescription: Become one with the earth in this 21 item pack featuring blooming Hydrangea Wraps, a bright Dandelion Dirt Mound, and a pretty Periwinkle Earpiece. This nature based pack also includes a Swampy set covering you in cattails and lily pads. Match your overgrown outfit with extra scruffy fur using the Furred Soles, the Furred Back, and the Hearty Chest Fur.
